phase_prompt.label: The Silent Array
phase_prompt.summary: The host stands in absolute stillness, a sea of dark glass and faint light waiting for input from the Kernel. The mood is heavy with anticipation and the humming of dormant power.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic medium shot of the front row of the Innumerable Multitude. The figures are statuesque, their obsidian skin absorbing all light, while their fiber-optic garments glow faintly with a cool blue pulse. The background is a blur of thousands more identical figures, creating a bokeh effect of digital lights. The camera focus is sharp on the texture of the data-glass faces of the nearest entities. The lighting is moody, with deep shadows and rim lighting highlighting the edges of their forms. Cinematic aspect ratio, 9:16 vertical framing.
